news.title: News diagnosis
news.intro: Why this match has news or not: the coverage, the market, the AI's passes, the paid searches and the Exa budget. Bogotá times.

verdict.not_tracked: Competition not followed: the AI neither analyses this match nor searches its news.
verdict.no_market: No market: not analysed and not searched. It joins the AI's day once it has odds.
verdict.kicked_off: Not searched, and the match has started or is less than 10 minutes away: no pass is left.
verdict.day_not_open: Not yet: the AI's day opens at 00:05 Bogotá time.
verdict.day_not_open_at: Not yet: the AI's day opens at 00:05 Bogotá time; first pass expected {when}.
verdict.exa_spent: Exa budget spent ({reason}): no new searches are made.
verdict.first_pending: The first pass has not run yet: it goes in the next cycle (every 15 minutes).
verdict.near_budget: Close to the budget limit: the passes kept the search for matches with a candidate.
verdict.covered_not_searched: It is in the guaranteed coverage, but its passes did not search (the day's or the pass's budget).
verdict.not_covered: Outside the guaranteed coverage and without a place among the day's searches: not searched.

coverage.yes: Yes: group {group}, searched at the first and pre-match passes even without a candidate.
coverage.no: No: group {group}. Searched only with a candidate or within the day's quota.
coverage.off: Turned off by the owner (group {group}): searched only within the day's quota.

market.no: No: no consensus prices in the last 36 hours

web.nearBudget: no search, close to the budget limit

news.rumorNote: Only aggregators, social posts or unclassified sites say these: do not take them as facts.

CONFIRMED.label: Confirmed
CONFIRMED.help: An official source with a date, the confirmed line-up or two independent outlets say it.

PROBABLE.label: Probable
PROBABLE.help: One outlet or journalist says it; no second source has confirmed it yet.

CONTRADICTORY.label: Contradictory
CONTRADICTORY.help: Sources of similar standing say opposite things and nothing newer settles it.

RUMOR.label: Rumour
RUMOR.help: Only aggregators, social posts or unclassified sites say it. Do not take it as a fact.

OUTDATED.label: Outdated
OUTDATED.help: Something newer superseded it, or it is too old for this match.

relevance.help: How much it bears on the match: high if it says who plays or not; medium if it is about the team or the coach without naming a player; low if it is context.
